data.narrative:
Blue Water Autonomy, a Series A-stage Defense & Security company founded by Rylan Hamilton and Austin Gray, has raised $64M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of 11 companies in the same sector at Series A and B stages, comprising 2 public comparables (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private peers including Anduril Industries, Helsing, and Singularity.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression modeling, using the $64M raised as a proxy for current post-money value and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A advancement, implies a valuation of $128M. Peer-median analysis across the 11-company comp set yields $1.0B, with the peer range spanning $125M (low) to $3.0B (high). The median peer valuations in the sample include Dream Security at $3.0B, Allen Control Systems at $2.2B, and Harmattan AI at $1.4B, all at Series B.

Triangulating both methods produces an estimated valuation range of $109M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $564M. The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty around Blue Water's competitive positioning relative to later-stage peers and the company's own revenue traction and defensibility, neither of which are provided in the available data. The stage-progression method anchors conservatively; peer-median reflects the sector's current funding environment but may not account for Blue Water's specific technical or commercial differentiation.
